title: Duality bound for the variation of a smooth function: ∫_{B_r}‖Dg‖ ≤ c (Simon Ch. 2, 2.5 (4))
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, let g : ℝ^m → ℝ be of class C^∞, and let r, c ∈ ℝ. Suppose ∫ g·div ψ dL^m ≤ c for every C^∞ vector field ψ : ℝ^m → ℝ^m with compact support, tsupport ψ ⊆ B_r(0) and |ψ(v)| ≤ 1 for all v, where div ψ(v) = trace Dψ(v). Then ∫⁻_{B_r(0)} ‖Dg(v)‖ dv ≤ c, read in [0, ∞] with c as ofReal c.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (g : Euclid m → ℝ) (r c : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → (∀ ψ : Euclid m → Euclid m, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid m) r → (∀ v, ‖ψ v‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ v, g v * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid m) (fderiv ℝ ψ v).toLinearMap ≤ c) → ∫⁻ v in ball (0 : Euclid m) r, ‖fderiv ℝ g v‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c
